text:
rachel: Quick thread to prep a "quicklaunch" integrator onramp pilot. Goal: 2-week intake, 3 partner orgs, lightweight seller checklist + trainer options. Meeting tomorrow 8am PT to finalize. Who can join?

omar: I'm in. Aim to keep artifacts minimal: TF/Helm quickstart, optional airgap tarball, and a one-page support blurb.

lina: For certification, propose two badges: Marketplace-Ready (packaging + smoke pass) and Trainer-Ready (runs cohort). Keep Marketplace-Ready quick to earn.

beth: Ops note: kits available NA/EU only. Cost ≈ $1.3k/kit shipped. We can reserve up to 5 for pilot if partnerships approves PO.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Reservation ticket PARTN-678 created to hold 3 kits for quicklaunch pilot; ticket expires in 9 days.

rachel: Nice. Marketplace checklist draft: 1) quickstart deploy succeeds in sandbox <30m, 2) smoke test passes, 3) images pinned to SHAs for airgap, 4) docs + support contact provided, 5) legal-approved DATA blurb.

legal-bot: legal-bot: Flag - need exact wording for data processing and demo dataset guidance. Recommend a short template for listings.

omar: We'll add a tiny smoke test snippet to the appendix. Keep it copy-paste ready:

omar: ```bash
export TOKEN=$SANDBOX_TOKEN
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","input":"hello"}' | jq .
ssh kit 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv'
```

lina: For sellers who can't ship kits, accept recorded deploy demo + live telemetry export from our sandbox for monitoring/rollback checks. Documented exception in FAQ.

beth: Ops constraint: airgap tarballs must be signed and accompanied by a manifest pinned to SHA256. We'll provide a small script to generate checksums.

rachel: Good. Ownership: I'll draft the marketplace copy + intake form. Omar: you own TF/Helm quickstarts. Lina: you own certification rubric. Beth: ops logistics and kit PO. Legal-bot: legal template.

omar: Timeline suggestion: quick draft by Tue EOD, smoke script + quickstarts by Wed, rubric by Thu, intake and PO by Fri. Pilot cohort starts two weeks from next Monday.

lina: Rubric highlights: Marketplace-Ready = pass smoke + docs; Trainer-Ready = runs a sandbox cohort + fills assessor reports for 3 participants. Allow recorded demos where necessary but require at least one live assessment.

beth: I'll file PARTN-679 for budget approval and confirm shipping windows once form is ready.

legal-bot: legal-bot: Will post template lines for data and SLA. Also require a support email and an escalation SLA (standard 72h).

omar: Small packaging note: publish quantized image as optional artifact to keep listing size small. Mention GPU/CPU requirements in quickstart.

rachel: Pilot scope: 3 sellers, private beta announcement after completion, metrics tracked: time-to-deploy, first-pass success %, and support tickets raised. Keep support load limited.

lina: Add trainer feedback + participant evaluation form to collect pass/fail reasons and common blockers. Helps tune labs.

beth: Ops: will only ship kits to corporate addresses with an approved PO and contact. Add that to intake form.

omar: I'll drop a minimal TF module example into the shared doc.

rachel: Ok team — I'll create calendar and pre-read (links) and post here. If you can't make tomorrow ping in this thread. Thanks! :thumbsup:
